text:
maya: heads-up — CI linkcheck failed for the docs site after the heading-normalize migration. Errors look like two things: (1) duplicated anchors in docs/guides/deploy.md (slug collision on "quick-start") and (2) multiple images missing alt text which mkdocs-linkcheck treats as warnings but docusaurus build is failing the linkcheck job.

devdocs-bot: CI: docs/site-build #482 failed on step `linkcheck` — see logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/482/logs

liam: can you paste the exact linkcheck error for the anchor collision? I suspect the slugify tweak doubled up ids when headings + captions generate same slug.

maya: log excerpt: ```
ERROR linkcheck: anchors: docs/guides/deploy.md: anchor collision: '#quick-start' already defined (from heading 'Quick Start')
WARN linkcheck: image without alt: docs/guides/deploy.md: ./assets/deploy/diagram.png
```

samir: yeah this smells like captioned images producing implicit header ids. Docusaurus slugify behavior differs from mkdocs in how it drops punctuation. Quick fix is to add explicit header id or an `{#id}` style. For MDX we can do `### Quick start {#quick-start-deploy}`.

ana: (typo, should be ana) I'll take the image alt text fixes — small PR to add descriptive alt text for the deploy diagram and any other missing alts across the guides.

ana: quick checklist: 1) search for `!\[\]\(` to find empty alts 2) run `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally 3) open a tiny PR with only alt updates so it's reviewable.

liam: for anchors I can add explicit ids on the two conflicting headings and add a short note in the migration guide about slug differences between mkdocs/docusaurus. Example change: ````md
### Quick start {#quick-start-deploy}
````

maya: perfect — let's avoid changing existing permalinks. If we add `{#...}` use the old slug prefix + '-deploy' so existing links to `#quick-start` don't break. Also add a redirect rule in the docs config if we have to.

samir: for automation: I'll add a small step in the docs CI that runs a script to detect duplicate slugs and fail fast with a helpful message. Something like: ````bash
python ./scripts/check_duplicate_anchors.py docs/ | tee /tmp/anchor-errors
if [ -s /tmp/anchor-errors ]; then exit 1; fi
````

ana: opened PR #712 with alt text changes for deploy diagram and a couple more. Running local linkcheck now.

devdocs-bot: PR #712 checks — linkcheck passed locally, CI queued.

liam: opened PR #713 with explicit ids on the two conflicting headings and a short note in docs/migration/slugify.md about the difference.

maya: thanks all — once both PRs merge, re-run the CI job. If linkcheck still complains, let's pair for 10 mins and I'll share the failing page stack trace. :thumbsup:

ana: merging #712 once CI is green.

samir: I'll draft the small script and drop it in tools/docs-lint, then we can iterate.

liam: FYI added a short line to the migration doc suggesting `id suffixing` as a safe pattern (e.g., `{#heading-deploy}`) to avoid collisions when re-slugifying.

maya: awesome. moving to close the incident once the build clears. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
